title: Area-code shard C pass 29 — 770 / 773 / 779

data.research_question: Which current or historically relevant public organizations, public professional actors, and communication surfaces can be verified in the next unresolved shard-C U.S. geographic NPAs 770, 773, and 779?
data.method: Bounded deterministic shard-C area-code enumeration using current NANPA geographic membership, literal and locality-derived searches, first-party/current-status verification, repository dedupe, public professional-role enumeration, historical-seed status checks, and explicit uncertainty handling. X and Reddit discovery did not depend on official APIs.
classification_rules: Historical directories are discovery seeds only; current-status verification is required before calling an organization active.
Do not infer individual political affiliation from organizational proximity, volunteering, attendance, membership, public role, or event participation.
Do not merge organizations or people from name or handle similarity alone.
Public person-org relations are directly stated unless qualifiers explicitly mark an inference.
For locality-derived NPA hits, geographic association does not imply a published phone number unless directly evidenced.

findings.notes: The Ke'nekt Cooperative is a new current identity with a directly published 770 number and first-party founder evidence. Food Not Bombs Atlanta was already canonical and was re-verified/reused rather than duplicated.

Rogers Park Food Not Bombs, PO Box Collective, and The Love Fridge are current Chicago public organizations. PO Box's current recurring program surface corroborates Rogers Park FNB. Historical Chicago ABC directory material was status-checked but not promoted as active.

DeKalb Mutual Aid is current and first-party material explicitly says last updated 2026 and identifies its board. Historical 815 Mutual Aid Network material was reviewed but insufficient current first-party activity was found, so it remains an unresolved status-check lead rather than an active org record.

data.narrative_role: bounded area-code organization and public-professional-role enumeration pass

summary: Bounded shard-C organization and public professional-role enumeration covering current U.S. geographic NPAs 770, 773, and 779.
